column1: # Release tracks: which packages version and publish together, and the git-tag prefix that
# releases each. Source of truth read by build/resolve-track.sh (tag -> track), BuildNugets.sh
# Why tracks exist: the packages sit on unrelated native version lines (RTC 4.6.x, RTM 2.2.x), so
# one tag publishing all of them stamps a release note that makes sense for none. A tag names one
# track; the release builds and publishes only that track, at its own pins.
# Tag scheme: the main RTC track uses a bare "v" (v4.6.2.1); every other track prefixes its
# product name (signaling-v2.2.8.1). resolve-track.sh matches the longest prefix, so "v" never
# There is no chat, fastboard or iot track: Agora ships no macOS SDK for those products.
# Columns are single-tab-separated. The third is space-separated package ids from
# build/packages.tsv; a trailing "*" is a prefix match (Extensions.* is the twelve extensions).
